craft_notes: Sthāyin: moment doctrine. Rows: divide, abide, necessitate. Rejected: softening — killed: necessity is the doctrine. Read aloud: hammered logic.

lines: Time-part alone parts knowing, not thing-part —
Knowing's long-abiding — that alone the wink;
in one breath-rise one knowing, needs must —
and this: else never a single notion-knowing could be,
since word-stained in rank, since ranked even the measure.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kālabheda eva saṃvedanabhedakaḥ na vedyabhedaḥ śikharasthajñānavat jñānasya yāvān avasthitikālaḥ sa eva kṣaṇaḥ prāṇodaye ca ekasmin ekam eva jñānam avaśyaṃ caitat anyathā vikalpajñānam ekaṃ na kiṃcit syāt kramikaśabdārūṣitatvāt mātrāyā api kramikatvāt
